comments.content: The `%s` substituted into the query is a compile-time constant ("DESC"/"ASC") so there's no SQL injection risk here, but note that `psprintf` allocates in the current memory context on every call. Since `continuous_agg_split_refresh_window` may be invoked frequently, confirm this runs in an appropriately scoped memory context to avoid leaking the formatted string. Consider using a static conditional pair of full query strings instead of psprintf to avoid the allocation entirely.
